import pandas as pd
from scipy import stats

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/vboxuser/.openclaw/workspace/data/housing_dataset.csv')

# Extract price and mainroad columns
price_col = 'price'
mainroad_col = 'mainroad'

# Create groups: yes (on main road) vs no (not on main road)
group_yes = df[df[mainroad_col] == 'yes']['price']
group_no = df[df[mainroad_col] == 'no']['price']

print(f"Group 'yes' size: {len(group_yes)}")
print(f"Group 'no' size: {len(group_no)}")
print()

# Perform independent samples t-test (equal variances assumed)
t_stat, p_value = stats.ttest_ind(group_yes, group_no, equal_var=True)

print(f"T-statistic: {t_stat}")
print(f"P-value: {p_value:.4f}")
print()

# Determine if difference is significant at alpha=0.05
alpha = 0.05
if p_value < alpha:
    sig_diff = "yes"
else:
    sig_diff = "no"

print(f"Difference is {'significant' if p_value < alpha else 'not significant'}")
